info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Offer Management API
info.description: The Customer Offer Management API allows for the dynamic modification of customer offers in the banking sales system. This API is designed for financial institutions seeking to update existing offers based on changing customer needs and preferences. Typical consumers include sales teams and customer service representatives who require real-time updates to offer details. Utilizing this API ensures that customers always receive the most relevant promotions, optimizing customer satisfaction and engagement.

patch.description: This operation allows for updating the offer details for a specific customer identified by their unique ID (CUST-100045). Ensure to provide the necessary data in the request body to make the desired changes to the customer's offer.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the customer offer details for the specified customer ID (CUST-100045). It contains the necessary fields for modifying the existing offer and is expected to be provided in JSON format.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the offer has been updated.
